subject: reasoning
question:
The sequence of folding a piece of paper and the manner in which the folded paper has been cut is shown in the given figures. How would this paper look when unfolded?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32ab55ec5329a491a5a385fa908124b857345882ab7a920fe76dbfe5baa61b2e.png]
solution:
The given figure:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32ab55ec5329a491a5a385fa908124b857345882ab7a920fe76dbfe5baa61b2e.png] 

When we will unfold the paper for the first time, we will get the shapes on the upper half that is vertically rotated by 180° as shown below

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da71ad1cf9b34e182d4bf152c49cccd6e2fdeea6f1e447daf6057d40714eb683.png] 

Again, when we will unfold the paper for the second time we will get similar shapes on the lower half of the paper as the shapes are horizontally symmetrical. The paper will look like the figure below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b1d9991e794c5c9a15cc370113dee1a6ba3708eb12bfe4ef20415cfc215ca9a.png] 

Hence,** "option 4"** is the correct answer
